data.title: 塑心 · 雨中的节拍
data.description: 雨点敲打窗沿，节奏时快时慢。她听了一阵，抬手在窗边轻轻跟着打拍子。
data.camera: 中景，雨窗与人物侧影同框
data.promptProse: Standing by a tall French bay window draped with sheer lace, Virtuosa taps her slender fingers against the cool glass in time with the erratic cadence of falling rain. Outside, glistening grey rooftops and misty streetlamps recede beneath the cool, diffused daylight.
data.animaCaption: Watching raindrops trace winding paths down the pane, she taps out a syncopated rhythm on the sill with a faint, enigmatic half-smile.
